title: Source Manifest
description: Stage-1 (Intake) artifact. Records the single local source file an init'd workspace was seeded from. The source itself lives at source.local_path inside the workspace; this manifest never carries raw source text. Written by scripts/init_workspace.py; consumed by the agent producing the downstream deck_brief / deck_plan / design_system / slide_plans / image_manifest stages 2-6.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. Bump only with a paired script change.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this source. The agent must declare this id in deck_brief.source_refs so downstream slides can cite it. ASCII letters, digits, underscore, dot, hyphen; must not start with a separator.

local_path.description: Workspace-relative path to the source file. Locked to the canonical 'input/source.md' that scripts/init_workspace.py always writes. The enum lock is the path-safety gate: a 'type: string, minLength: 1' schema would let unsafe values like '../../etc/passwd', '/abs/path', or 'file:///etc/passwd' through with a schema-level false-green. A future intake variant that wants a different local path must bump schema_version and extend this enum (a paired change, like every other contract in this repo).

kind.description: How the source should be parsed by downstream stages. 'markdown' for .md files, 'text' for .txt files.

byte_count.description: Byte length of the UTF-8 source file. Zero-length sources are refused by init_workspace.py.

line_count.description: Number of lines in the source (count of '\n' plus one if the file does not end in '\n').

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the source bytes. Defense-in-depth: a downstream consumer can detect a mutated input/source.md by re-hashing and comparing.

name.description: The intake tool that wrote this manifest. Closed enum; any other writer must add a paired schema bump.

version.description: Intake tool version, bumped only with a paired script change.
